title: Right-pinched component comparison respects concrete corepresentable postcomposition
statement:
Use quasicategories, right-pinched mapping spaces and path components of geometric realizations from [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and the concrete corepresented coherent functors of [def-coef-infinity-category-of-spaces]. Work in fixed universes large enough for all the following constructions. Let $C$ be a quasicategory small in the ambient universe, let $x,y,z$ be vertices, put $A=\mathfrak C[C]$, $P_t=\operatorname{Map}^R_C(x,t)$, and let $H_x:C\to\mathcal S$ be the specific functor with $H_x(t)=\operatorname{Sing}|A(x,t)|$ defined in [def-coef-infinity-category-of-spaces]. Write $p_{P_t}:|P_t|_Q\to P_t$ and $\theta_t:|P_t|_Q\to A(x,t)$ for the specified weak homotopy equivalences of [lem-coef-pinched-rigidification-resolution], and $u_t:A(x,t)\to\operatorname{Sing}|A(x,t)|$ for the characteristic-map unit of [lem-cbc-realization-singular-unit-weak]. Define the component bijection
$$\beta_t=\pi_0(u_t)\,\pi_0(\theta_t)\,\pi_0(p_{P_t})^{-1}:\pi_0P_t\longrightarrow\pi_0H_x(t).$$
For every edge $g:y\to z$ and every $a\in\pi_0P_y$, the postcomposition class of [lem-coef-infinity-mapping-composition] satisfies
$$\beta_z([g]a)=\pi_0(H_x(g))(\beta_y(a)).$$
Here $H_x(g)$ means the actual enriched postcomposition map associated to the image of $g$ under the displayed coherent functor. In particular, for every $2$-simplex of $C$ with edges $f:x\to y$, $g:y\to z$, and $w:x\to z$, one has
$$\beta_z([w])=\pi_0(H_x(g))(\beta_y([f])).$$
The assertions concern this specified comparison with the concrete singular-realization model, rather than an unspecified equivalent Hom functor. No compactness, filteredness, colimit, connectedness, or Kan condition on the simplicial sets $A(x,t)$ is assumed.

The subset inclusion {0,2} into {0,1,2} in Definition 1.1.5.1 supplies the triangle compatibility.
